description: Find a mobile phone number for each contact by calling the buyer's own phone data providers in order (Prospeo, Lusha, ContactOut, FullEnrich) until one returns a number. Returns one row per contact with the number in E.164 format, its line type, country, a Do Not Call flag where the provider reports one, the provider that found it, and the provider credits it spent, plus a run summary row. Provider keys are read from the PROSPEO_API_KEY, LUSHA_API_KEY, CONTACTOUT_API_KEY, and FULLENRICH_API_KEY environment variables of this server; with none set, the run completes, calls nothing, and charges only the run start fee. A LinkedIn URL is passed to providers as an identifier and never opened. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per contact searched and per number found, plus the buyer's own provider credits.

contacts.description: People to look up. Give each as many identifiers as you hold.

company_domain.description: Company website domain, for example example.com.

company_name.description: Company name, used when no domain is known.

email.description: Work or personal email, which Prospeo and Lusha can match on.

first_name.description: First name, if you hold it separately.

full_name.description: Full name, for example Jane Doe.

id.description: Your own id, echoed back as contact_id.

last_name.description: Last name, if you hold it separately.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL. The strongest identifier for most providers; passed to them, never opened.
Single contact shortcut: LinkedIn profile URL, never opened by the actor.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional cap on this run's Apify charges. The run stops before a charge that would pass it and keeps every row already paid for.

max_contacts.description: Ceiling on how many contacts this run processes.

max_provider_credits.description: Cap on the provider credits this run may spend on the buyer's own accounts. Remaining contacts are skipped, uncharged. Strongly recommended.

mobile_only.description: When true, a landline or VoIP number does not count as found and the chain moves on. Numbers with no reported line type are kept as unknown. Default true.

provider_order.description: Providers in call order. Default prospeo, lusha, contactout, fullenrich. A provider with no key is skipped and reported.

name: find_mobile_phone
title: Find mobile phone
